stories.description: Row notes on a horizontal bar chart follow their category through a re-sort. The value axis of a horizontal chart is `x`, so the Goal line takes `x`.

stories.name: Dumbbell Row Notes
stories.description: Row notes on a `DumbbellChart`: the Coimbra note follows its row through the `delta` sort (Coimbra sorts second), the target band sits behind the tracks and the dashed average line over them.

stories.name: Dumbbell From Spec
stories.description: The same dumbbell from `ChartSpec.annotations`, rendered by `AutoChart`.

stories.name: Waterfall Notes
stories.description: A `WaterfallChart` hands its annotations to the inner bar chart: a row note, a note, a line.

charts/areachart.name: AreaChart
charts/areachart.title: Charts/AreaChart
charts/areachart.summary: Cumulative or part-of-whole trend over time — a filled line.

intent.purpose: Cumulative or part-of-whole trend over time — a filled line.
antiPatterns: Stacking areas that are not parts of one whole — a stack asserts summation; use lines.
Overlapping opaque areas — either stack them or switch to a LineChart.
Leaving status="loading" unhandled — AreaChartLoading is the shipped skeleton.
dataShapes: measures over time where magnitude matters — stacked, or as a stream with offset="wiggle"
intent.avoidWhen: fewer than about 4 points — a bar chart reads the same data faster

props.name: data
props.description: Data array - each item should have a date field and numeric values

props.name: xDataKey
props.description: Key in data for the x-axis (date). Default: "date"

props.name: xScale
props.description: How `xDataKey` values are interpreted (#352). Default: `"time"`. - `"time"` — Date (or Date-coercible) x values on a time scale. - `"band"` — categorical x values (`"Turn 1"`, `"Step A"`), evenly spaced in first-seen order. Axis ticks, the ticker and the tooltip title all show your own value, not a formatted date. - `"linear"` — numeric x values spaced by magnitude. Omitting it keeps today's behaviour, except that a dataset whose x values are ALL non-Date-coercible degrades to `"band"` (with a dev warning) instead of collapsing.

props.name: margin
props.description: Chart margins

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: Animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 1100

props.name: animationEasing
props.description: CSS easing for clip-reveal. Default: cubic-bezier(0.85, 0, 0.15, 1)

props.name: enterTransition
props.description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

props.name: revealSignature
props.description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers reveal replay when it changes.

props.name: revealOn
props.description: When the enter reveal is allowed to play (#175). `"mount"` (default) plays as soon as the chart renders — no change from today. `"inView"` holds the reveal at width 0 until this chart's own container scrolls to 30% visible.

props.name: replayOnClick
props.description: Clicking the chart body replays the enter reveal (#175). Default `false`.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. Wins over `aspectRatio`, which stays an alias.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container

props.name: status
props.description: Loading vs ready — drives chart phase and loading chrome. Default: `"ready"`.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Centered shimmer label while loading.

props.name: yDomainTweenDuration
props.description: Animate y-domain over this duration (ms) on status transitions. Default: 500.

props.name: yDomainTween
props.description: Animate y-domain when status or target domain changes. Default: true

props.name: xDomain
props.description: Visible x-domain for brush zoom.

props.name: xDomainSlotCount
props.description: Full dataset length for x-scale padding when `xDomain` is set.

props.name: tweenYDomainOnXDomainChange
props.description: Tween y-domain when brush changes the visible x-range. Default: false

props.name: style
props.description: Inline container styles (e.g. fixed height for brush strip).

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Fires when the internal chart phase changes (e.g. OG capture readiness).

props.name: children
props.description: Child components (Area, Grid, ChartTooltip, etc.)

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Drill-down (#349). Fires when a datapoint is activated by pointer OR keyboard. Setting it mounts a keyboard-operable target layer OUTSIDE the aria-hidden SVG — one tab stop, arrow keys to traverse. Leaving it unset changes nothing: no extra DOM, no new focusables.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Put the datapoint's exact value on the clipboard when it is activated — the recovery path for a compact axis label. Default `false`; a chart with no interaction props still renders byte-identical DOM. A consumer-supplied `onDatapointClick` always wins.

props.name: datapointLabel
props.description: Override the accessible name of each keyboard drill-down target (#349).

props.name: maxInteractiveDatapoints
props.description: Dev-warning threshold on the number of keyboard targets. Default 500 (#349).

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. series names + value range).

props.name: offset
props.description: Streamgraph baseline (RM-029) — maps to `d3-shape`'s `stackOffsetNone` / `Silhouette` / `Wiggle` / `Expand`. Unset (default): no stacking — every child `Area` renders independently, exactly as today. Set it to stack every child `Area` (in JSX order) using that baseline; `"silhouette"` is the F16 lieflat "Stream Ribbon" look.

props.name: seams
props.description: Paper gap between stacked bands, in px — a `--chart-background` stroke drawn along each band's own top edge. Only takes effect when `offset` is set. Default: 0 (no seam). 2 is the F16 lieflat value. When set (> 0), the seam owns the band's edge (#245): the band's own crest stroke is suppressed there so the paper gap is what separates the ribbons, rather than the two painting the same path on top of each other.

props.name: labelBands
props.description: Label each stacked band with its series name at the band's widest x (`HaloText`, clamped inside the plot). Only takes effect when `offset` is set. Default: false.

props.name: nulls
props.description: Container-level default for an `Area`'s own `nulls` prop (RM-112). Unset — every `Area` keeps its own default (`"gap"`).

props.name: focusOnHover
props.description: Hovering (or, on touch, tapping) one series dims every other series to the shared selection-excluded opacity (RM-112, `dw-river.md` §2.3). Default false — today's behaviour.

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend engine (RM-118): `true` or a config object mounts `ChartLegend` beside the plot via `useContainerLegend`; `{ interactive: "toggle" }` hides a band and re-tweens the y-domain. Unset (default) renders NOTHING new (R1, moved into `useContainerLegend` itself) — RM-110's end labels stay the default multi-series key for `AreaChart`.

props.name: dataKey
props.description: Key in data to use for y values

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: Y-scale group id (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill color for the area gradient start. Default: var(--chart-line-primary)

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Fill opacity at the top of the area. Default: 0.4

props.name: stroke
props.description: Stroke color for the line. Default: same as fill

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width. Default: 2

props.name: curve
props.description: Curve interpolation — a named alias (`"linear"` | `"monotone"` | `"natural"` | `"step"` | `"step-before"` | `"step-after"`, RM-112) or a raw `@visx/curve` factory. Default: `"monotone"` (unchanged).

props.name: animate
props.description: Whether to animate the area. Default: true

props.name: showLine
props.description: Whether to show the stroke line. Default: true

props.name: showHighlight
props.description: Whether to show highlight segment on hover. Default: true

props.name: gradientToOpacity
props.description: Gradient opacity at bottom. Default: `0` (fully transparent) for an ordinary, unstacked area — the bottom edge is the y-axis baseline, not the encoding, so fading toward it costs no information. For a STACKED band (`AreaChart offset` set, #245) the default instead follows `fillOpacity` — a flat wash — because in a stacked/stream area BOTH edges are the encoding (band thickness is the value) and fading one away destroys it. Pass an explicit value (including `0`) to override either default.

props.name: gradientSpan
props.description: Vertical extent of the fill gradient (0–1). `1` fades across the full height; lower values compress the gradient toward the top.

props.name: fadeEdges
props.description: Fade the area fill (and stroke) toward transparent at the chart edges. - `true` fades both edges, `false` disables the fade entirely. - `"left"` / `"right"` fades only that side — useful when the opposite edge butts up against another element you don't want to fade into. Default: false

props.name: showMarkers
props.description: Render scatter-style circle markers at each data point. Default: false

props.name: markers
props.description: Marker styling (same options as Scatter).

props.name: symbols
props.description: Placement/style wrapper over `showMarkers`/`markers` (RM-112) — same shape and resolution rule as `Line symbols` (shared helper, `resolveSeriesSymbols`): unset → no symbols; set without a `placement` on a series with more than 12 points → also no symbols (avoid symbols on a dense, regularly-sampled series); otherwise `placement` defaults `"ends"`, `style` defaults `"hollow"`. Setting this turns markers on regardless of `showMarkers`.

props.name: dashFromIndex
props.description: Data index from which the line stroke becomes dashed (inclusive). Useful for projecting incomplete periods, e.g. dashed from yesterday through today.

props.name: dashArray
props.description: Dash pattern for the tail segment when `dashFromIndex` is set. Default: "6,4"

props.name: nulls
props.description: How this area draws a non-numeric sample (RM-112). Overrides the container-level `AreaChart nulls` default. Unset — read the container default, or `"gap"` with no container default (a visible break in the fill/crest at that sample, never a silent zero).

props.name: loadingStroke
props.description: Pulse stroke color while chart is loading. Default: var(--foreground)

props.name: loadingStrokeOpacity
props.description: Pulse stroke opacity while chart is loading. Default: 0.5

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the loading pulse overlay. Default: follows chart loading phase. Set `false` to disable even during loading.

props.name: loadingPulseMode
props.description: Override pulse animation mode (loop / exit / enter).

props.name: labelPeaks
props.description: Ring the peak sample with a filled dot + value label (RM-029). Only takes effect when this `Area` renders as a `HairlineArea` — a single-series chart under high decoration (`data-decoration` ≥ 8). Default: false.

props.name: name
props.description: Series display name — the text of its end label, key item and auto summary (RM-110). Default: `dataKey`.

props.name: seriesLabel
props.description: Where the series names itself (RM-110): `"end"` | `"key"` | `"none"`, or a `Responsive` value. Default: as `LineProps.seriesLabel` (two or more series, and only for a series with a real `name`). Read by the chart shell, which reserves the margin and places every label in one pass.

props.name: valueLabels
props.description: Automatic value labels (RM-110) — see `LineProps.valueLabels`.

props.name: lowKey
props.description: Key in data for the band's lower edge. Ignored (and optional) when `from="zero"` — the low edge is the value-axis zero line instead.

props.name: highKey
props.description: Key in data for the band's upper edge.

props.name: from
props.description: Bracket the band between `highKey` and the value-axis zero line instead of a second series (Datawrapper: area fill "between a line and zero"). `lowKey` is ignored when set.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill colour. Default `var(--chart-ring-background)` — the same quiet "normal range" wash `Sparkline`'s `band` prop already draws with.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Fill opacity. Default 1 — the token itself already carries the wash.

props.name: negativeFill
props.description: Fill colour for any segment where the high edge dips BELOW the low edge (`highKey < lowKey`, or `highKey < 0` under `from="zero"`) — Datawrapper's negative-difference fill (River bar-line combination recipe). Unset: the whole band paints `fill` regardless of sign — today's behaviour.

props.name: curve
props.description: Curve function, matching the series it brackets. Default `curveMonotoneX`.

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: Y-scale group id (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

props.name: margin
props.description: Chart margins

props.name: stroke
props.description: Stroke color for the animated loading segment.

props.name: strokeOpacity
props.description: Stroke opacity for the animated loading segment. Default: 0.5

props.name: gridStroke
props.description: Grid line stroke (color and opacity via color-mix or oklch alpha).

props.name: gridShimmerStroke
props.description: Shimmer band stroke (color and opacity via color-mix or oklch alpha).

props.name: gridShimmer
props.description: Animate a shimmer band across grid lines. Default: true

props.name: gridShimmerLength
props.description: Shimmer band width in pixels. Default: 140

props.name: gridShimmerSpeed
props.description: Shimmer speed multiplier (higher = faster). Default: 1

props.name: gridShimmerSync
props.description: Match shimmer loop to the loading line pulse (cycle + inter-loop pause).

props.name: label
props.description: Centered shimmer label text. Default: "Loading"

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container

props.name: numTicks
props.description: Explicit tick count (including first and last) — the long-standing override; wins over `tickCount`. Default: unset (→ `tickCount`).

props.name: tickCount
props.description: Tick target (RM-108). `"auto"` (default) derives it from the plot width — `tickTargetForWidth(innerWidth)`, about one tick per 90 px, clamped 2–10, and never more than the number of data rows on a time axis (6 monthly rows get at most 6 ticks, not 9 labels between them).

props.name: ticks
props.description: RM-108 naming, shared with `YAxis`. On a time axis: an alias of `tickValues` (`tickValues` wins). On a numeric x with `domain`/`scale` (ScatterChart): exactly these raw x values.

props.name: domain
props.description: Numeric x only (ScatterChart with numeric `xDataKey`, RM-108): pin either end of the x domain in raw units; `"auto"` keeps the data-derived end. Read by the chart container, so place `XAxis` as a direct child. Setting `domain` or `scale` also switches the labels from one per data row to a numeric ruler. Ignored on a time axis.

props.name: scale
props.description: Numeric x only (RM-108): `"linear"` (default), `"log"` (refuses data or a domain touching 0 — dev warning, renders linear) or `"sqrt"`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which edge the labels sit on (RM-108). Default: `"bottom"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Axis title (RM-108).

props.name: titlePlacement
props.description: `"outside"` (default) — in the margin beyond the tick labels, at the far end; `"inside"` — `HaloText` at the far end inside the plot.

props.name: tickerHalfWidth
props.description: Width of the date ticker box for fade calculation. Default: 50

props.name: tickMode
props.description: `"domain"` — evenly spaced ticks across the time domain (default). `"data"` — one label per data row at its x value (better with sparse or monthly bars).

props.name: tickFormat
props.description: Override the default `Intl`-based tick label formatter. Applied to every tick this axis renders (generated or `tickValues`). #357. **Time scale only.** Ignored (with a dev warning) when the chart runs `xScale="band" | "linear"` — those modes project onto a synthetic instant, so a `Date` formatter would print a fabricated calendar date instead of your x value. Format categorical/numeric x values in your data. #352.

props.name: dateFormat
props.description: The date-format LADDER (RM-109): a preset from `date-format.ts` (`"year"` → `"yearShort"` → `"month"` → `"day"` → `"weekday"` → `"hour"` → `"minute"`), or a formatter function for full control. Unset (default) — the axis picks a rung itself via `dateFormatForSpan`, from the time domain's span and how many ticks are on screen, instead of the old fixed `"Mon d"` shape whatever the span. A ten-year series reads years; a 36-hour series reads hours. `tickFormat` still wins outright when both are set — it is the raw escape hatch this package has always had; `dateFormat` is the smart default underneath it. Same time-scale-only caveat as `tickFormat` (#352).

props.name: tickValues
props.description: Render exactly these tick positions, bypassing tick generation AND the default label-collision de-dupe entirely — use when the default de-dupe would collapse the axis (e.g. dense data whose formatted labels collide). #357. **Time scale only** — see `tickFormat`. #352.

props.name: periodTicks
props.description: Draw a `HairlineFloor` (RM-017) below the plot — one hairline tick per calendar period, whether or not a data row falls on it, with the long tick anchored to a real calendar boundary (day → the first day of the week, week → the first week of the month, month → January), not an index stride from wherever the series happens to start (#253). Lieflat provenance: the ruled foot of a ledger page gives a reader the passage of time with no labels and no axis. This is a SEPARATE visual layer from the labelled ticks above (`numTicks` / `tickMode`) — it never changes which labels render or where. `false` (default) draws nothing — today's behaviour.

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: Scale group id (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which side of the chart to render labels. Default: `"left"`.

props.name: numTicks
props.description: Explicit tick count hint for `scale.ticks()` (d3) — the long-standing override; wins over `tickCount`. Actual label count may differ. Clamped to {@link Y_AXIS_MIN_TICK_COUNT}–{@link Y_AXIS_MAX_TICK_COUNT}. Default: unset (→ `tickCount`).

props.name: tickCount
props.description: Tick target (RM-108). `"auto"` (default) derives it from the plot height — `tickTargetForHeight(innerHeight)`: 3 under 200 px, else 5.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Render exactly these tick values (RM-108), bypassing generation.

props.name: domain
props.description: Pin either end of the value domain (RM-108); `"auto"` keeps the data-derived end. Read by the chart container, so place `YAxis` as a direct child. On a length encoding (bars) the domain always includes 0 — a non-zero lower bound is ignored with a dev warning (`charts-honesty`).

props.name: scale
props.description: How values map to pixels (RM-108). `"log"` refuses data or a domain that touches 0 (dev warning, renders linear); bars are linear only. Default: `"linear"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Axis title — names the unit of every tick (RM-108).

props.name: titlePlacement
props.description: `"outside"` (default) — above the top tick label in the margin; `"inside"` — `HaloText` at the top of the axis inside the plot.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: `"outside"` (default) — tick labels in the margin beside the plot; `"inside"` — labels sit just above their grid line inside the plot.

props.name: formatLargeNumbers
props.description: @deprecated Superseded by `valueFormat` (see `charts/value-format.ts`), which knows about millions as well as thousands — the old implementation rendered 1 500 000 as `1500k`. `false` still works and is equivalent to `valueFormat="number"`; `true` is now the default behaviour and can be dropped. Removed in the next major (`docs/DEPRECATION.md` §1).

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How tick values are rendered. Default: `"compact"` — `1.5M`, not `1500k` and not `1500000`. Pass `"number"` for every digit.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for `valueFormat: "currency"`. Falls back to `ChartConfigProvider`, then `"USD"`.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Custom formatter for tick labels. Overrides `valueFormat` entirely when set.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit text appended to {@link unitOn} tick(s) — `<YAxis unit="%" />` paints `"80 %"` on that tick, not every tick (RM-109). The tooltip is the place a unit repeats on every value (the blog's "3.4 % unemployed", not a bare "3.4 %"); see `TooltipRow.unit`.

props.name: unitOn
props.description: Which tick(s) {@link unit} paints on. Default: `"last"`.

stories.name: With Accessible Label
stories.description: Accessible variant — announces label + description to screen readers on focus.

stories.name: Streamgraph
stories.description: `AreaChart offset="silhouette"` — three product lines composed into a streamgraph, centered around zero rather than a hard baseline. Band order (bottom → top) follows JSX order: desktop, tablet, mobile.

stories.name: Stream With Seams
stories.description: `seams={2}` — a `--chart-background` stroke drawn between bands, the F16 "paper seam" that visually separates each ribbon from its neighbour. `seams` IS this package's separator-lines feature for stacked areas (Datawrapper's "separator lines" option) — there is no additional `separatorLines` prop.

stories.name: Hairline Decoration
stories.description: High decoration (`data-decoration="10"`) on a SINGLE-series `Area`: renders a `HairlineArea` — one 0.55px vertical hairline per sample, a 1.2px crest — instead of the usual pattern fill (lieflat F3 Hairline Area). `labelPeaks` rings the max sample with a filled dot + value label.

stories.name: Hairline Decoration Off
stories.description: `data-decoration="0"` (the default) — the same single-series chart renders its ordinary solid fill, byte-identical to `Default` above; no hairlines.

stories.name: Nulls
stories.description: `nulls` (RM-112). `"gap"` (the default) breaks the fill/crest at a non-numeric sample; `"connect"` bridges straight across it; `"zero"` (the pre-RM-112 default) reads it as 0 — same three modes, same resolution, as `Line`'s `nulls`.

stories.name: Symbols
stories.description: `symbols` (RM-112) — the same shared `resolveSeriesSymbols` rule as `Line symbols`: unset placement on a ≤12-point series defaults to hollow markers at the first/last point only.

stories.name: Focus on hover
stories.description: `focusOnHover` (RM-112) dims every OTHER series to `SELECTION_EXCLUDED_OPACITY` while the pointer (or the legend) is over one — same behaviour, same wide invisible hit-stroke, as `Line`'s `focusOnHover`.

stories.name: Selection states
stories.description: `selectionStates` paints the host’s tri-state on each category’s column: selected marks carry a compound foreground/background outline, excluded marks dim AND carry a full-opacity dashed frame, so the three states stay distinguishable in greyscale.

stories.name: Legend toggle
stories.description: Container legend (RM-118): `legend={{ interactive: "toggle" }}` mounts `ChartLegend` above the plot with real `aria-pressed` buttons — click, or Tab then Enter, hides a series and the y-domain re-tweens around what is left visible. `focusOnHover` reuses the same fade a pointer-hovered area already had for a keyboard-focused legend item (Refs #545).

charts/autochart.name: AutoChart
charts/autochart.title: Charts/AutoChart
charts/autochart.summary: Spec-driven chart — hand it a serializable ChartSpec and it picks and renders the right chart.

intent.purpose: Spec-driven chart — hand it a serializable ChartSpec and it picks and renders the right chart.
antiPatterns: Hand-picking a chart type when the spec already encodes the intent — AutoChart is the agent-facing entry point.
Putting raw colors in a spec's series — the chart-1…chart-5 tokens are the palette in every theme.
Passing an empty dataset with no not-ready signal — render the loading state instead of an empty frame.

props.name: spec
props.description: The serializable chart specification produced by an LLM tool-call. `spec.type` is optional; omit it and the data shape decides (see `explainChartType`). The full `ChartType` union AutoChart renders is: `line` | `area` | `bar` | `pie` | `scatter` | `radar` | `funnel` | `candlestick` | `heatmap` | `calendar` | `waterfall` | `dumbbell` | `unit` | `treemap` | `histogram` | `box` | `strip` | `bump` | `stream` | `diverging-bar` | `dual-axis`. Anything else — including `network`, `parallel`, `tree` and `sankey`, which stay explicit-container-only — renders `ChartFallback` instead. That list is not hand-kept prose: `auto-chart.test.tsx` parses it back out of this comment and asserts it equals `CHART_TYPES`, so a type added to the union without being documented here fails the suite.

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: Height of the drawing area only; the title and legend stack around it. A number of pixels, `{ aspect }` (width / height), or a per-breakpoint `{ base, medium?, narrow? }`. Default: the chart family's own default (`{ aspect: 2 }` wide, `{ aspect: 1.25 }` narrow for the 2:1 families).

props.name: height
props.description: @deprecated Use `plotHeight`. Removed in 5.0.0. Until then it is read as `plotHeight` and logs one development warning per page.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading vs ready — renders a layout-shaped skeleton at the normal chart height instead of resolving `spec`. Default: `false`.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Copy a datapoint's EXACT value to the clipboard when it is activated by pointer or keyboard. Default **`true`** here, unlike the raw chart containers, which default it to `false`. The asymmetry is deliberate. `AutoChart` renders compact axis labels (`1.5M`) from a spec its caller never sees the axis config for, so without this there is no way to recover the exact figure. A raw container's caller owns the axis and can format it themselves, and turning this on mounts the datapoint interaction layer — which would break the documented guarantee that a chart with no interaction props renders byte-identical DOM. Set `false` to keep `AutoChart`'s pre-existing DOM (no interaction layer, no keyboard targets).

props.name: selectionStates
props.description: Selection input (RM-073), forwarded to the chosen container. The resolver's `category` is read from `spec.fields.category` (default `spec.x`), so a host maps selection without knowing the chart type.

props.name: dimExcluded
props.description: Dim `excluded` marks. Default `true`. Forwarded with `selectionStates`.

props.name: hoverCategory
props.description: Shared-crosshair category from a sibling chart (RM-073).

props.name: onHoverCategory
props.description: Fires with the hovered category on pointer move, `null` on leave (RM-073).

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Forwarded to the chosen container's own `onDatapointClick` (RM-075), when that family accepts one (bar, line, area/stream, pie, waterfall, heatmap/calendar, dumbbell, unit, treemap, histogram/box/strip, bump, funnel, diverging-bar). Absent on scatter/radar/candlestick — those containers don't accept it yet. Unset by default, so the default render stays byte-identical (#349's own rule: "with it unset the chart renders exactly as before").

stories.name: Line Inferred
stories.description: Line chart inferred from temporal x data (no explicit type).

stories.name: Bar Grouped
stories.description: Grouped bar chart with three regional series.

stories.name: Bar Stacked
stories.description: Stacked bar chart — same data, stacked mode.

stories.name: Donut
stories.description: Donut chart with a center hole.

stories.name: Scatter
stories.description: Scatter chart with numeric x (ad spend vs conversions).

stories.name: Radar
stories.description: Radar chart comparing two teams across five metrics.

stories.name: Funnel
stories.description: Funnel chart showing a conversion pipeline.

stories.name: Currency Formatted
stories.description: Currency-formatted y-axis via the `valueFormat` hint (line chart).

stories.name: Copy Exact Value
stories.description: Values are compacted on the axis and in the tooltip, so the exact figure has to stay reachable: `AutoChart` defaults `copyValueOnActivate` to `true`, which mounts the keyboard datapoint layer (real buttons OUTSIDE the aria-hidden `<svg>`) and a persistent polite live region for the "copied" announcement. Clicking or pressing Enter on a point copies its exact value.

stories.name: Copy Exact Value Disabled
stories.description: `copyValueOnActivate={false}` opts the tile out entirely — no datapoint layer, no live region, and the chart's DOM is what it was before the feature existed.

stories.name: Unsupported Fallback
stories.description: A type outside the `ChartType` union renders a `ChartFallback`. `sankey` is one of the four shapes AutoChart deliberately never infers or renders — a flat spec cannot express a node/link graph unambiguously, so it stays explicit-container-only. The panel speaks to the reader (“This chart can’t be displayed.”) and is a settled result, not a live region; the type name goes to a dev console warning instead (#304).

stories.name: Empty Data
stories.description: Empty data array renders a "No data to display" fallback.

stories.name: Loading
stories.description: Loading vs ready (#268) — a layout-shaped skeleton at the chart's normal height.

stories.name: In Chat Conversation
stories.description: InChatConversation — shows AutoChart embedded inside an AI tool-call output. Uses a minimal token-styled mock shell (plain divs) instead of the full `@elabs-ai/components-ai` Conversation/Message/Tool stack, keeping this story self-contained within the `@elabs-ai/components-charts` package (which does NOT depend on `@elabs-ai/components-ai`). The REAL composition with `@elabs-ai/components-ai`'s Conversation/Message/Tool/ToolOutput components lives in the copy-owned `ai-chart` registry block (`registry/blocks/ai-chart/`) — a registry block may import both siblings, whereas a package (and therefore a package's story) may not. See `research/ai-charts/01-ai-chart-integration-plan.md`.

stories.name: Candlestick Inferred
stories.description: OHLC columns on a date axis are candles, never a line.

stories.name: Treemap Inferred
stories.description: A nested hierarchy is the one shape only a treemap can read.

stories.name: Treemap Palette
stories.description: `palette` on a treemap spec (#306): colour is a DATA encoding here — `"categorical"` encodes the top-level group, `"sequential"` the leaf value, `"mono"` (the default) nothing. Everything else about the spec is unchanged.

stories.name: Bump Inferred
stories.description: Long `(period, entity, rank)` rows DECLARED as a ranking. Without the declaration the identical shape reads as a heatmap — the two cannot be told apart structurally, which is why the ranking rule runs first and asks for a signal.

stories.name: Calendar Inferred
stories.description: A year of dated rows is more days than a line can resolve.

stories.name: Stream Inferred
stories.description: Stacked bands over time read as a streamgraph, not as lines.

stories.name: Heatmap Inferred
stories.description: Two categorical keys and one measure make a matrix, whatever the row count.

stories.name: Dumbbell Inferred
stories.description: Two measures whose names read as before/after are one measure twice.

stories.name: Histogram Inferred
stories.description: A bare column of observations has no category to plot against.

stories.name: Strip Inferred
stories.description: Few enough records per group and every one can still be drawn.

stories.name: Box Inferred
stories.description: Past ~200 records a group, the summary reads better than the records.

stories.name: Waterfall Inferred
stories.description: A total/net/gross checkpoint row makes these deltas rather than categories — and it outranks the diverging rule, which this same data also satisfies.

stories.name: Diverging Bar Inferred
stories.description: A single measure that crosses zero: the baseline is the story.

stories.name: Unit Inferred
stories.description: The same shares that would draw a pie draw countable marks instead once the spec asks for the editorial register — `emphasis: "editorial"` is the only difference between this story and a pie.

stories.name: Line Legend From Column Keys
stories.description: A series known only by its column key (no `label`) is NOT end-labelled (RM-110), so the legend engine's default shows a legend — forwarded through `spec.legend` into `LineChart`'s own `legend` prop (`LEGEND_ENGINE_TYPES`), never a second, `AutoChart`-owned implementation. The rendered `.legend-container` is byte-identical to an explicit `<LineChart legend>` built from the same normalized series (see `auto-chart.test.tsx`'s "renders the identical legend DOM…" test, and `LineChart`'s own `LegendToggle` story for the equivalent explicit call).

stories.name: Line Faceted Legend
stories.description: `ChartSpec.facet` (RM-120) splits one line spec into a grid, one panel per `region` — and `legend: true` (RM-118) shows ONE shared `Chart legend` above the whole grid, not one per panel and not the old per-chart `AutoLegend` a faceted spec briefly lost across the wave-2 branch merge.

stories.name: Bar Faceted Legend
stories.description: RM-118 Part B × RM-120, sitting 2: `bar` joined `LEGEND_ENGINE_TYPES` this wave, so a faceted bar spec gets the same fix as `LineFacetedLegend` above — ONE shared `Chart legend` over the whole grid, never one per panel.

stories.name: Pie Faceted Legend
stories.description: RM-118 Part B × RM-120, sitting 2 (fix round 1, item 3): the pie half of `BarFacetedLegend` above — same ONE-shared-`Chart legend`-over-the-grid treatment, but the items must be the slice CATEGORIES (deduped across panels via `pieRows`, the same source the retired `<AutoLegend>` used), never the value column and never one legend per panel. This is the exact regression class the sitting-2 `legendItems`-not-`series` fix in `auto-chart.tsx` guards — see the matching unit tests in `auto-chart.test.tsx`'s "AutoChart faceted pie legend" block.

stories.name: Dual Axis Spec
stories.description: `type: "dual-axis"`: order counts as columns on the left scale, the conversion rate as a line on the right. `axes.y2.align: "ticks"` puts both scales on the same gridlines; the legend splits by side and the tooltip is a table with a header per axis.

stories.name: Dual Axis Spec Without Line
stories.description: A dual-axis spec with no line series cannot be drawn honestly: `ChartFallback` says so.

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: Scale group id (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which side of the chart to render labels. Default: `"left"`.

props.name: numTicks
props.description: Explicit tick count hint for `scale.ticks()` (d3) — the long-standing override; wins over `tickCount`. Actual label count may differ. Clamped to {@link Y_AXIS_MIN_TICK_COUNT}–{@link Y_AXIS_MAX_TICK_COUNT}. Default: unset (→ `tickCount`).

props.name: tickCount
props.description: Tick target (RM-108). `"auto"` (default) derives it from the plot height — `tickTargetForHeight(innerHeight)`: 3 under 200 px, else 5.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Render exactly these tick values (RM-108), bypassing generation.

props.name: domain
props.description: Pin either end of the value domain (RM-108); `"auto"` keeps the data-derived end. Read by the chart container, so place `YAxis` as a direct child. On a length encoding (bars) the domain always includes 0 — a non-zero lower bound is ignored with a dev warning (`charts-honesty`).

props.name: scale
props.description: How values map to pixels (RM-108). `"log"` refuses data or a domain that touches 0 (dev warning, renders linear); bars are linear only. Default: `"linear"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Axis title — names the unit of every tick (RM-108).

props.name: titlePlacement
props.description: `"outside"` (default) — above the top tick label in the margin; `"inside"` — `HaloText` at the top of the axis inside the plot.

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: `"outside"` (default) — tick labels in the margin beside the plot; `"inside"` — labels sit just above their grid line inside the plot.

props.name: formatLargeNumbers
props.description: @deprecated Superseded by `valueFormat` (see `charts/value-format.ts`), which knows about millions as well as thousands — the old implementation rendered 1 500 000 as `1500k`. `false` still works and is equivalent to `valueFormat="number"`; `true` is now the default behaviour and can be dropped. Removed in the next major (`docs/DEPRECATION.md` §1).

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How tick values are rendered. Default: `"compact"` — `1.5M`, not `1500k` and not `1500000`. Pass `"number"` for every digit.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for `valueFormat: "currency"`. Falls back to `ChartConfigProvider`, then `"USD"`.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Custom formatter for tick labels. Overrides `valueFormat` entirely when set.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit text appended to {@link unitOn} tick(s) — `<YAxis unit="%" />` paints `"80 %"` on that tick, not every tick (RM-109). The tooltip is the place a unit repeats on every value (the blog's "3.4 % unemployed", not a bare "3.4 %"); see `TooltipRow.unit`.

props.name: unitOn
props.description: Which tick(s) {@link unit} paints on. Default: `"last"`.

stories.name: Width Derived Ticks
stories.description: x ticks follow the plot width: ~9 at 900 px, ~3 at 380 px.

stories.name: Pinned Tick Count
stories.description: `numTicks` pins the count at every width (the `sm` density would still cap it at 4).

stories.name: Log Scale
stories.description: A log ruler from a pinned lower bound, titled inside the plot.

stories.name: Log Refused On Zero
stories.description: Data containing 0: `scale="log"` warns once in development and draws linear.

stories.name: Wrapped Category Labels
stories.description: 18-character categories at a ~96 px band step break onto two lines, never tilted.

stories.name: Grid Ticks Mode
stories.description: `Grid mode="ticks"`: short hairlines at the axis edge only — no rule crosses the plot.

stories.name: Grid Off
stories.description: `Grid mode="off"`: no furniture at all.

stories.name: Inside Labels Top Axis
stories.description: Labels inside the plot, a pinned domain, and the x axis on top.

stories.name: Bar Value Domain
stories.description: A pinned bar range: the value axis ends at exactly 100, not the data-derived 80.

stories.name: Bar Domain Keeps Zero
stories.description: Bars encode length, so a raised floor is refused: `domain={[20, 100]}` keeps the upper bound and draws from 0 (with a dev warning).

stories.name: Composed Domain Keeps Zero
stories.description: A composed chart with bars shares the bar rule: the floor stays at 0.

stories.name: Auto Chart Axes
stories.description: The same axis controls from a serialisable `ChartSpec.axes`.

charts/barchart.name: BarChart
charts/barchart.title: Charts/BarChart
charts/barchart.summary: Categorical comparison — composed from Bar + BarXAxis/BarYAxis inside its provider.

intent.purpose: Categorical comparison — composed from Bar + BarXAxis/BarYAxis inside its provider.
antiPatterns: Truncating the value axis so small differences look large — a bar axis starts at zero.
Hardcoding series colors — use the chart-1…chart-5 tokens so every theme works.
Rendering an empty frame before data arrives — use the shipped chart skeleton utilities.
dataShapes: categorical comparison of one or more measures across a small set of named categories
a single signed measure around a meaningful zero, as diverging bars with a zero line
intent.avoidWhen: a time axis with many points — use a line or area chart

props.name: data
props.description: Data array - each item should have an x-axis key and numeric values

props.name: xDataKey
props.description: Key in data for the categorical axis. Default: "name"

props.name: margin
props.description: Chart margins

props.name: animationDuration
props.description: Animation duration in milliseconds. Default: 1100

props.name: animationEasing
props.description: CSS easing for bar grow transitions.

props.name: enterTransition
props.description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

props.name: revealSignature
props.description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers enter replay when it changes.

props.name: revealOn
props.description: When the enter reveal is allowed to play (#175). `"mount"` (default) plays as soon as the chart renders — no change from today. `"inView"` holds the bars at their pre-enter state until this chart's own container scrolls to 30% visible.

props.name: replayOnClick
props.description: Clicking the chart body replays the enter reveal (#175). Default `false`.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. Wins over `aspectRatio`, which stays an alias.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container

props.name: status
props.description: Loading vs ready — shows skeleton chrome + placeholder bars while `"loading"`. Default: `"ready"`.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Centered shimmer label while loading.

props.name: barGap
props.description: Gap between bar groups as a fraction of band width (0-1). Default: 0.2

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Fixed bar width in pixels. If not set, bars auto-size to fill the band.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Bar chart orientation. Default: "vertical"

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack bars instead of grouping them. `true` stacks raw values; `"percent"` normalises each category to 100 % (value axis 0–100 %, a `YAxis` without its own format prints percent, `showValues` prints shares); `"diverging"` centres `divergingCenter` on the zero line with the series declared before it growing left/down and those after it right/up (Likert rows). Default: false

props.name: stackGap
props.description: Gap between stacked bar segments in pixels. Default: 0

props.name: divergingCenter
props.description: `stacked="diverging"`: the series straddling zero (e.g. `"Neutral"`). Unset: the series split in half.

props.name: stackOrder
props.description: Segment order inside each stack (`stacked`/`"percent"`). Default: `"data"` (declaration order).

props.name: showTotals
props.description: Print each stack's total just past its end. Default: false

props.name: sort
props.description: Row order: by value (`"asc"`/`"desc"`, the stack total when stacked) or `{ by, dir }`. Default: `"none"`.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverse the (sorted) row order. Default: false

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Gather rows by this column: horizontal bars get a bold header row per group, vertical columns a header above each group; groups are separated by a hairline and keep their own (sorted) order.

props.name: colorBy
props.description: Colour each bar by another column through `resolvePalette` (six hues, then the neutral ladder with a dev warning) and show a colour key. One key per chart (RM-118 R4): whenever this produces a non-empty colour key, the `legend` container legend below YIELDS and renders nothing — `colorBy`'s own key already covers the same job, and `interactive: "toggle"` has no effect in that mode (there is no container legend to press).

props.name: track
props.description: Paint a track behind each bar to the axis maximum ("to 100 %"). `true` uses `--chart-mono-2`, a mark-weight grey; `{ fill }` names another ink — a surface tone such as `var(--chart-segment-background)` when the track should read as paper, not as data. Default: false

props.name: overlays
props.description: Value markers and range spans drawn per bar on top of the series; listed in `legendItems`.

props.name: comparison
props.description: A muted prior-period column behind each main column (the main column narrows to make room).

props.name: comparisonLabel
props.description: Grey label beside each comparison pair. Default: `"none"`.

props.name: children
props.description: Child components (Bar, Grid, ChartTooltip, etc.)

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Reports reveal lifecycle for OG screenshots and loading orchestration.

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Drill-down (#349). Fires when a bar is activated by pointer OR keyboard. Setting it mounts a keyboard-operable target layer OUTSIDE the aria-hidden SVG — one tab stop, arrow keys to traverse. Unset changes nothing.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Put the datapoint's exact value on the clipboard when it is activated — the recovery path for a compact axis label. Default `false`; a chart with no interaction props still renders byte-identical DOM. A consumer-supplied `onDatapointClick` always wins.

props.name: datapointLabel
props.description: Override the accessible name of each keyboard drill-down target (#349).

props.name: maxInteractiveDatapoints
props.description: Dev-warning threshold on the number of keyboard targets. Default 500 (#349).

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. series names + value range).

props.name: palette
props.description: Default fill for `Bar` children that don't set their own `fill`, via `resolvePalette` (RM-018) over the series count — so, for example, nine unfilled `Bar` series degrade to the neutral ladder with a dev warning instead of nine bars painted identically. A `Bar` with an explicit `fill` is never touched. Default: `"categorical"` (`resolvePalette`'s own default) — but see `applyBarPalette`: it only ever assigns colours to SERIES THAT WOULD OTHERWISE COLLIDE (2+ unfilled `Bar` children), so a chart with a single unfilled `Bar` keeps today's `--chart-line-primary`.

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend engine (RM-118): `true` or a config object mounts `ChartLegend` beside the plot via `useContainerLegend`; `{ interactive: "toggle" }` turns each item into a real `aria-pressed` button that hides a series on grouped OR stacked bars — the value domain (`resolveBarValueDomain`, always zero-based) recomputes from the VISIBLE series only, and the hidden series' `<Bar>` never mounts, so it drops out of the datapoint layer too. `interactive: "hover"` (default) dims the other series via the existing `ChartLegendHoverProvider` seam `Bar` already reads. Unset renders NOTHING new (R1). Yields to `colorBy`'s own key — see its doc (R4, one key per chart).

props.name: dataKey
props.description: Key in data to use for y values

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: Y-scale group id for vertical bars (Recharts `yAxisId`). Default: `"left"`.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill color for the bar. Can be a color, gradient url, or pattern url. Default: var(--chart-line-primary)

props.name: stroke
props.description: Color for tooltip dot. Use when fill is a gradient/pattern. Default: uses fill value

props.name: lineCap
props.description: Line cap style for bar ends: "round", "butt", or a number for custom radius. Default: "round"

props.name: animate
props.description: Whether to animate the bars. Default: true

props.name: animationType
props.description: Animation type: "grow" (height) or "fade" (opacity + blur). Default: "grow"

props.name: fadedOpacity
props.description: Opacity when not hovered (when another bar is hovered). Default: 0.3

props.name: staggerDelay
props.description: Stagger delay between bars in seconds. Auto-calculated if not provided.

props.name: stackGap
props.description: Gap between stacked bars in pixels. Default: 0

props.name: groupGap
props.description: Gap between grouped bars in pixels. Default: 4

props.name: showValues
props.description: Print each bar's value as a `HaloText` label (the `text-chart-value` role, 800-weight — lieflat G3 Chunky Bars). `true`/`"outside"` place it just past the bar's far end; `"inside"` places it just inside. A negative bar's label is signed with a "−" (U+2212, not a hyphen) glyph. A bar narrower than `MIN_LABEL_BAR_WIDTH` hides its label rather than shrinking below `text-meta`. Default: off. A {@link BarShowValuesSpec} (RM-110) adds `"auto"` placement and hover-only visibility. In a stack drawn from a layout (percent, diverging, ordered or totalled — RM-113) each segment centres its label whatever the placement, a percent segment prints its share, and a segment shorter than 24 px along the value axis stays unlabelled.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How `showValues` prints this series' numbers — a preset or a spec (`{ suffix: " %" }`, `{ style: "currency", abbreviate: true }`, `{ sign: "always" }`). One notation for the whole series, as without it. Unset: today's locale number. A percent stack still prints shares.

props.name: unit
props.description: Draw each bar as a countable `UnitStack` of `floor(value / unit)` rungs (vertical bars, `kind="rung"`) or ticks (horizontal bars, `kind="tick"`) instead of a solid fill — lieflat F1 Rung Bars. The rung pitch is derived from the value scale, not the bar's own pixel span, so one rung is worth the same amount in every column and the ladder never counts past the bar's own value (#241) — a value that is not an exact multiple of `unit` draws an honest partial. Width and opacity jitter via `seededRnd`, keyed per bar so neighbours never jitter in lockstep; every 5th unit draws heavier so the stack stays countable. Renders instantly (no `animate`/`animationType` grow-in). Default: off (solid fill).

props.name: highlightKey
props.description: Mark ONE bar as this series' "hero": it draws in `--chart-foreground` ink while every OTHER bar draws from `palette` instead of `fill` — lieflat's one-hero-bar-in-ink convention. A string/number is matched against the bar's category value; a function receives `(datum, index)`. Default: off (every bar draws `fill`).

props.name: palette
props.description: Palette the non-hero bars draw from when `highlightKey` is set, via `resolvePalette` (RM-018). Default: `"categorical"`.

props.name: zeroLine
props.description: Draw a 0.8px `--chart-foreground-muted` hairline at the zero baseline across the whole plot. Default: auto — shown whenever ANY bar series in this chart has a negative value; pass `false` to force it off on this series, or `true` to force it on even with all-positive data.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the tick labels sit. Default: `"bottom"`.

props.name: numTicks
props.description: About how many ticks to aim for. Default: 5, fewer when the plot is narrow.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How the tick values print — a preset or a spec (`{ suffix: " h" }`). Default: `"compact"`.

props.name: title
props.description: A short name for the axis, printed after the last tick ("hours").

props.name: tickerHalfWidth
props.description: Width of the date ticker box for fade calculation. Default: 50

props.name: showAllLabels
props.description: Keep every category (never stride over labels). Default: false. NOTE this no longer forces HORIZONTAL rendering: with dropping disabled the axis may still tilt, ellipsize, or hide itself when the labels cannot fit.

props.name: maxLabels
props.description: Maximum number of labels to show. Default: 12

props.name: fit
props.description: How labels that do not fit their band are rescued (RM-108): - `"auto"` (default) — horizontal → two-line `wrap` → 45° tilt → ellipsis → stride → hidden; - `"wrap"` — the same cascade without the tilt rung (never rotates); - `"tilt"` — the pre-RM-108 cascade (skips `wrap`); - `"off"` — pins the pre-fit behaviour: full labels, count-capped stride, no measurement and no reserved axis space. The regression escape hatch.

props.name: showAllLabels
props.description: Keep every category (never stride over labels). Default: true. NOTE this no longer implies every label renders in full: the axis still ellipsizes to the gutter it has, and hides itself when nothing legible fits.

props.name: maxLabels
props.description: Maximum number of labels to show. Default: 20

props.name: fit
props.description: `"off"` pins the pre-fit behaviour — full labels, count-capped stride, no measurement and no reserved gutter. The regression escape hatch. Default: `"auto"`.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: The widest the label gutter may grow, in px. The gutter is measured from the labels and capped so a long name cannot eat the plot; the default cap suits one or two words. Raise it for rows whose names ARE the content — "Send Invoice → Payment Reminder" — and the chart still keeps its own minimum plot width. Default: 112.

props.name: items
props.description: Legend items to display

props.name: hoveredIndex
props.description: Currently hovered index (for highlight effect)

props.name: onHover
props.description: Callback when an item is hovered

props.name: onItemClick
props.type: ( item: LegendItem, index: number, event: React.MouseEvent | React.KeyboardEvent, ) => void
props.description: Drill-down on a legend entry (#349). When set, each item renders as a real `<button>` — keyboard operable and named by the item's label — instead of a `<div>`. Unset, the legend is unchanged (a non-interactive `<div>` list). NOTE this lives on `ChartLegend`, not on the chart containers: the legend is a separately-placed composition primitive, so a callback on the container would be a prop the container cannot honour.

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description: Series toggle (RM-118, `legend={{ interactive: "toggle" }}`). Set together with `onToggleKey`: every item renders as a real `<button aria-pressed>` — native keyboard support, no extra wiring — and `hiddenKeys` marks which ones read `aria-pressed="false"` and paint dimmed with a struck-through label (WCAG 1.4.1: hidden is never colour-only). Independent of `onItemClick` (drill-down); a container sets one or the other.

props.name: onToggleKey
props.type: (key: string, item: LegendItem, index: number) => void
props.description: Toggles one item's hidden state. Keyed by `item.key ?? item.label`.

props.name: hideAtDensity
props.description: Density tiers that hide the whole legend (RM-072 default: `xs`/`sm`). The container legend engine (`useContainerLegend`, RM-118) passes `["xs"]` — `sm` renders `stack`-laid-out instead of hiding — so this stays `["xs", "sm"]` for every OTHER (direct) caller, unchanged.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Show progress bars. Default: false

props.name: showMarker
props.description: Show color marker dot. Default: true

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show numeric value column. Default: true

props.name: showPercentage
props.description: Show percentage value. Default: true when showProgress is true

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format function for displaying values. Overrides `valueFormat` entirely when set.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How to format `value`/`maxValue` (RM-109) — a preset or the object form (`{ decimals, abbreviate, sign, prefix, suffix, … }`, `value-format.ts`). Resolved as a SET across every item (#250, `useChartValueSetFormatter`) so the legend never mixes "1K" beside "400". Default: locale-aware plain grouping (`intFmt`), unchanged from before this prop existed.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for `valueFormat: "currency"`. Falls back to `ChartConfigProvider`, then `"USD"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown above the legend

props.name: layout
props.description: Item flow direction (RM-118, sitting 3). `"stack"` (default — every caller before this prop existed) is byte-identical to before: one item per line. `"row"` wraps items left-to-right (`flex-wrap`), matching the layout `AutoChart`'s old `AutoLegend` used, AND drops the `w-full` an interactive (`onItemClick`/toggle) item otherwise gets — `w-full` inside a row would force every item onto its own line regardless of this prop. `useContainerLegend` (the container legend engine) passes its own resolved `layout` ("row" at `base`/`medium`/`wide`, "stack" at `narrow` or density `sm`) through; a direct caller may set its own or leave it unset for the original stacked behaviour.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Class name for the title

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Class name for each legend item

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Class name for the label

props.name: valueClassName
props.description: Class name for the value

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (props: { item: LegendItem; index: number; isHovered: boolean; isFaded: boolean; percentage: number; }) => ReactNode
props.description: Custom render function for legend items

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Default grouped bar chart with two series and a tooltip.

stories.name: Single Series
stories.description: Single-series bar chart — simplest usage.

stories.name: Stacked
stories.description: Stacked bar chart — segments are stacked on the same bar.

stories.name: Horizontal
stories.description: Horizontal orientation — bars grow left-to-right.

stories.name: Horizontal Long Labels
stories.description: `BarYAxis maxWidth`: rows whose names ARE the content. The label gutter is measured and capped at 112 px by default, which ellipsises "Send Invoice → Payment Reminder"; raising the cap lets the gutter grow to what the labels need, and the plot keeps its own minimum.

stories.name: Long Category Labels
stories.description: Long labels that cannot fit their band tilt to 45° and ellipsize to the band the chart reserved for them. The full name stays available to assistive tech via an `sr-only` twin, so "Q1 Wester…" is never what a screen reader reads.

stories.name: Many Categories
stories.description: Forty categories in 560px: no band is wide enough for its label and none is wide enough to tilt into, so the axis strides over categories and re-enters horizontally at the wider effective slot.

stories.name: Narrow Container
stories.description: The same long labels in a card-sized column — the cascade trims harder.

stories.name: Tiny Container
stories.description: Below the legibility floor the axis hides itself rather than shipping a row of overlapping fragments. The bars still read; the category names move to the tooltip and to the chart's accessible description.

stories.name: Fit "off" (escape hatch)
stories.description: `fit="off"` pins the pre-fit render — full labels, count-capped stride, no measurement and no reserved band. The escape hatch for a chart whose layout was tuned against the old behaviour.

stories.name: Horizontal With Category Axis
stories.description: Horizontal bars with the side category axis. A side axis never tilts — rotated row labels are a legibility regression — so it ellipsizes into a gutter the chart widens to fit, instead of clipping at a constant 70px.

stories.name: Loading
stories.description: Loading vs ready (#268) — placeholder categories/bars while `status="loading"`.

stories.name: Drilldown
stories.description: Click a bar to drill into it; the detail panel below reports the datum.

stories.name: Keyboard Drilldown
stories.description: The same drill-down reached with the keyboard only — one tab stop for the whole chart, ArrowRight to traverse, Enter to activate.

stories.name: Density comparison
stories.description: #394: the axis tick label reads the `text-meta` ROLE (was the raw `text‑xs` utility, which `data-density`/#340 cannot reach). Two columns pin `data-density` on a plain wrapping div — NOT `<ThemeProvider>`, which writes `data-density` to `document.documentElement` and would race two columns — mirroring `Foundations/Typography → Density scale`'s pattern. Must match `Gantt`'s already-density-aware timescale tick (11.25px compact / 12px comfortable / 12.75px spacious, styling-and-tokens.md).

stories.name: With Values
stories.description: `showValues` prints each bar's value as a `HaloText` label (the `text-chart-value` role) — lieflat G3 Chunky Bars. `animate={false}` settles the labels immediately for a stable story.

stories.name: Unit Rungs
stories.description: `unit` draws each bar as a countable `UnitStack` of `floor(value / unit)` rungs instead of a solid fill — lieflat F1 Rung Bars. Renders instantly (no grow-in). The rung pitch comes from the value scale (not the bar's own pixel span), so one rung is worth the same amount in every column, and the ladder never counts past the value it encodes (#241).

stories.name: Diverging
stories.description: Negative values draw BELOW the zero baseline (lieflat G10 Diverging Bar): capsule radius on the outer end only, and the zero hairline auto-shows because at least one value is negative.

stories.name: Diverging — high decoration
stories.description: #254: `Diverging` pinned to high decoration — the render path `Diverging`'s own lock cannot see. At `--decoration` 8-10 `bar.tsx` swaps the palette fill for a `url(#bp-series-…)` pattern (ADR 0011); this story proves that swap actually fires (not merely that a selector tolerates it) so the broadened `data-slot` selector above is verified on both render paths, not just one.

stories.name: Highlight
stories.description: `highlightKey` marks ONE bar as the series' "hero" — it draws in `--chart-foreground` ink while every other bar draws from `palette` instead of `fill` — lieflat's one-hero-bar-in-ink convention.

stories.name: Mono Palette
stories.description: Nine unfilled `Bar` series exceed the categorical palette's 6-series soft cap (RM-018), so `resolvePalette` auto-degrades to the neutral mono ladder and logs a dev-only warning — a naive multi-series chart never silently paints two series the same colour.

stories.name: Reveal In View
stories.description: Three stacked `BarChart`s with `revealOn="inView"`. Only a chart that has actually scrolled 30% into view grows its bars; the ones below the fold stay held (no timer lapses them into "ready" off-screen). Under reduced motion nothing is held — a below-the-fold chart shows its bars without scrolling.

stories.name: Replay On Click
stories.description: `replayOnClick`: clicking the chart body replays the bar grow; the button above is the keyboard equivalent. Under reduced motion a click does not put the grow back on screen.

stories.name: Selection states
stories.description: `selectionStates` paints the host's tri-state: selected bars carry a compound foreground/background outline, excluded bars dim AND carry a full-opacity dashed frame, so the three states stay distinguishable in greyscale.

stories.name: Likert diverging stack
stories.description: Likert rows as a diverging stack: `stacked="diverging"` with `divergingCenter="Neutral"` centres the neutral answers on the zero line; disagreement grows left, agreement right. Sign is carried by side AND by the value labels, never by hue alone.

stories.name: Percent stack
stories.description: The same answers as `stacked="percent"`: every category normalised to 100 %, the value axis reads 0–100 % and each segment prints its share.

stories.name: Stacked with totals
stories.description: `stacked` + `stackOrder="desc"` + `showTotals`: largest segment first, the total past each stack.

stories.name: Range overlays, grouped
stories.description: The range-bar recipe: two range overlays (light 90 %, dark 50 %) and an average tick per model, grouped by class with a bold header per group. The overlays are listed in the legend items the chart exposes.

stories.name: Sorted, coloured by region
stories.description: `sort="desc"` + `colorBy={{ key: "region" }}`: value order, one hue per region, and a key.

stories.name: Comparison columns
stories.description: `comparison={{ key: "prev" }}`: last year as a muted column behind each quarter, grey differences on top.

stories.name: Track bars
stories.description: `track`: a grey bar to the axis maximum behind each bar — "what is missing".

stories.name: Signed horizontal
stories.description: The signed reading: negative bars grow left from the zero line and every label sits at its bar's end, signed with a real minus.

stories.name: Values on hover
stories.description: `showValues={{ visibility: "hover" }}`: a value label only for the hovered category.

stories.name: Legend toggle
stories.description: Container legend (RM-118): `legend={{ interactive: "toggle" }}` mounts `ChartLegend` above the plot with real `aria-pressed` buttons — click, or Tab then Enter, hides a series. The value domain recomputes from the visible series only, and stays zero-based (`resolveBarValueDomain`, charts-honesty). Works the same on a grouped or a `stacked` chart.

stories.name: Legend toggle, stacked
stories.description: `interactive: "toggle"` on a STACKED bar chart, at the chart's DEFAULT `animationDuration` (1100ms) — deliberately not zeroed out (RM-118 fix round 1, item 3: "not exercised live"), so this story runs the real non-zero-duration path a validator drives live in a browser, not the `animationDuration={0}` path every unit test uses. Every assertion after a state change goes through `waitFor` rather than a synchronous `expect` right after the click/keypress — the bar-enter tween on mount and the toggle's own stacked-segment tween both run for real here, so reading DOM geometry synchronously would race the animation instead of asserting its settled result. `BarChart`'s toggle recompute (`lines`, `bar-chart.tsx`) isn't gated by the reveal timer the way `LineChart`/`AreaChart`'s shared `time-series-chart-shell` used to be (see that shell's "recomputes even when toggled mid-reveal" test and `line-chart.stories.tsx`'s "Legend toggle" story, RM-118 validator FAIL 1a round 2), but this story still exercises the toggle against the real timer end to end rather than assume it.

stories.name: Legend yields to the colorBy key
stories.description: One key per chart (R4): RM-113's `colorBy` key already names every bar's colour, so the container legend engine yields — `legend` is set, but nothing new mounts, and there is no toggle affordance in this mode.

dataShapes: a single value against a target and 2–3 qualitative bands
intent.avoidWhen: more than one value/target pair needs comparing — use a small-multiple row of bullets or a `DumbbellChart`

props.name: value
props.description: The actual value — drawn as the bar.

props.name: target
props.description: The target — drawn as a tick, taller and darker than the bar.

props.name: comparative
props.description: A second reference (e.g. last year) — a small marker, a distinct shape from the target tick.

props.name: bands
props.description: Qualitative ranges (ascending `to`), drawn as 2–3 neutral steps behind the bar.

props.name: min
props.description: Scale floor. Default `0` — bars are zero-based; a caller-supplied negative floor is only honored when `value` itself is negative.

props.name: max
props.description: Scale ceiling. Default: the largest of `value`/`target`/`comparative`/the last band's `to`, "nice"-rounded with 5% headroom.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Bar direction. Default `"horizontal"`.

props.name: size
props.description: `"sm"` (default) is word-sized with no axis; `"md"` adds a hairline tick axis.

props.name: showAxis
props.description: Show the hairline tick axis. Default `size === "md"`.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How the value/target/comparative numbers are formatted. Default `"compact"`, one notation shared across the whole scale.

props.name: labels
props.description: Caller-supplied names interpolated into the auto-generated accessible description.

props.name: higherIsBetter
props.description: Whether ASCENDING band values read better (default `true`). Bands are always drawn low→high by position (`to` is ascending), but which END is "worst" depends on the measure: a lower-is-better KPI (e.g. cost) has its worst band at the HIGH end. Flips which side of the shade ramp gets the darkest (worst) rung so the visual always reads poor→good in the metric's own good direction, never just left→right.

stories.name: Default
stories.description: `size="md"` with bands + a target — the standard reading, axis included.

stories.name: With Comparative
stories.description: A second reference (last year) drawn as a small triangle notch, a shape distinct from the target's tick.

stories.name: Over Target
stories.description: The value clamps visually at the domain ceiling once it passes the target — the accessible name still states the real number.

stories.name: No Bands
stories.description: No `bands` prop — a single neutral track behind the bar.

stories.name: Lower Is Better
stories.description: `higherIsBetter={false}` — a lower-is-better measure (e.g. cost). The worst band sits at the HIGH end here, so the shade ramp mirrors: the darkest rung shades the high (worst) end instead of the low end.

stories.name: Vertical
stories.description: `orientation="vertical"` — the bar grows upward; the parent box supplies the height.

stories.name: Small In Card
stories.description: `size="sm"` (the default) — word-sized, no axis, sitting inline inside a narrow card.

charts/bumpchart.name: BumpChart
charts/bumpchart.title: Charts/BumpChart
charts/bumpchart.summary: Rank over discrete time — who is #1 changes over time. variant="lines" plots the trajectory (rank as an inverted y-axis); variant="strip" is the G21 filmstrip (fixed rows, shade + a printed number carry the per-period rank).

intent.purpose: Rank over discrete time — who is #1 changes over time. variant="lines" plots the trajectory (rank as an inverted y-axis); variant="strip" is the G21 filmstrip (fixed rows, shade + a printed number carry the per-period rank).

stateTokens.hero: highlightKey draws var(--chart-foreground) (ink) + bold labels; every other entity draws from the neutral mono ladder, never a second categorical hue
stateTokens.rank: variant="strip" cell shade = --chart-seq-1…7 via resolvePalette("sequential", maxRank) — rank 1 is always the most-ink step, whichever theme is active
stateTokens.delta: showDelta reads var(--success) for a climb (▲) and var(--destructive) for a drop (▼) via profitLossColor — colour reinforces the arrow glyph, it never stands alone
stateTokens.missing: a period an entity has no row for draws a QuietDot pinprick, never a blank cell

antiPatterns: Passing neither valueKey nor rankKey — there is no honest rank to derive, and every row is silently dropped rather than plotting a guessed order.

Mixing rankKey and valueKey inconsistently across periods — rankKey, when present, wins outright per row; a dataset that supplies rank for some periods and expects value-derived rank to fill the rest will jump between two different orderings.

Choosing variant="lines" for more than ~10-12 entities — crossing lines stop being followable well before maxEntities' default cap of 10 kicks in; variant="strip" reads a crowded field better because rows never move.
Reading the strip's row POSITION as the current rank — rows are fixed at each entity's FINAL rank; only the cell shade and its printed number carry the rank at any other period.
dataShapes: rank of several entities over ordered periods
intent.avoidWhen: only 2 periods — use a dumbbell chart

props.name: data
props.description: Long-format data — one row per (period, entity) pair.

props.name: period
props.description: Key in `data` for the discrete period (e.g. "Q1", "2026-W12").

props.name: entity
props.description: Key in `data` for the entity being ranked.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key in `data` for the entity's value that period. Ranks are derived from it when `rankKey` is absent.

props.name: rankKey
props.description: Key in `data` for an already-computed rank (1 = best). Takes priority over a derived rank when present.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"lines"` (default) — one line per entity on an inverted rank y-axis. `"strip"` — G21's fixed-row filmstrip: shade + a printed number carry the per-period rank instead of vertical position.

props.name: highlightKey
props.description: The hero entity — drawn in ink (`var(--chart-foreground)`) and bold; every other entity draws from the neutral mono ladder.

props.name: showDelta
props.description: Show a ▲n / ▼n delta flag (rank movement into the LAST period) per row. Default `false`.

props.name: maxEntities
props.description: Cap on plotted entities, kept by final rank. Default `10`; dev-warns once when the data has more. For `variant="strip"` this is also intersected with the largest row count whose printed rank still fits legibly (#273) — a raised `maxEntities` that would no longer fit is quietly lowered and warned about by name, never silently dropped to colour-only.

props.name: maxPeriods
props.description: `variant="strip"` only: cap on plotted periods (columns), kept as the MOST RECENT N — a rank race reads right-to-left, so the oldest periods are the meaningful ones to drop. Defaults to the largest column count whose printed rank still reaches the legibility floor for the chart's current width; dev-warns once naming `maxPeriods` when data (or an explicit value) would cross it (#273). Ignored by `"lines"`.

props.name: palette
props.description: Which colour family the `"strip"` cell shade draws from. Default `"sequential"` (rank 1 = most ink). Ignored by `"lines"`, which always draws hero-ink + mono.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How the tooltip's raw value cell is formatted. Default `"compact"`.

props.name: margin
props.description: Chart margins.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as `"width / height"`. Default `"2 / 1"`.

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. Wins over `aspectRatio`, which stays an alias.

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. entity count + period range).

stories.name: Default
stories.description: `variant="lines"` (default) — rank is derived from `share`; Atlas overtakes Nimbus in Q2 and the two lines visibly cross.

stories.name: Highlighted
stories.description: `highlightKey` draws one entity in ink (bold end labels), the rest on the neutral mono ladder — the "one line is the point" read.

stories.name: Rank Strip
stories.description: G21 Rank Strip — "Flows climbs to the top": rows stay fixed at final rank, shade + the printed number carry the per-quarter rank, the hero row (Flows) is bold and its delta flag reads ▲3.

stories.name: Lines Many Entities
stories.description: 8 entities × 6 periods in a short plot — eight end labels cannot sit `END_LABEL_MIN_GAP` px apart, so the chart keeps only the top and bottom rank (plus the hero, when set) and leaves the rest to the tooltip and datapoint layer (#281). Every label it does draw stays legible and inside the plot.

stories.name: Rank Strip Dense Grid
stories.description: A `strip` cell never renders its fill without also rendering its rank (WCAG 1.4.1) — even at 14 periods in a 480px box, where the raw column width would otherwise be too narrow for a legible numeral.

stories.name: Keyboard Drilldown
stories.description: Every plotted point is a keyboard datapoint target — a real `<button>` in a `pointer-events: none` layer BESIDE the `aria-hidden` SVG, never inside it. The target's accessible name carries the RANK, the chart's entire visual encoding — never only the metric a `valueKey` supplies (#270).

charts/bydatashape.name: ByDataShape
charts/bydatashape.title: Charts/ByDataShape
charts/bydatashape.about: Charts / By data shape (RM-041). lieflat-charts (see `docs/review/2026-09-04-lieflat-charts-gap-analysis.md`) is navigated by DATA SHAPE, not by component name — a reader looking for "two time points per category" lands on the right template without ever knowing it is called a dumbbell chart. The rest of this Storybook is organised by package/component (`docs/STORYBOOK_GUIDELINES.md`), which is right for maintainers and wrong for the "what chart do I need" moment. This file is that second index: one story per data shape, each rendering the recommended `@elabs-ai/components-charts` container against a small illustrative dataset, with the alternatives named in its docs description. It renders every container this package ships from `charts/index.ts` at least once (24, enumerated 2026-09-04) — it introduces NO new package code, only new example compositions of existing exports. This is an INDEX, not a catalogue of variants — each container's own `Charts/<Name>` story is still the place for its full API surface. Keep this file to one story per data shape.
